name: Comswest
summary: Perth ISP + corporate IT&T (Comswest International Pty Ltd, ACN 081 430 426, from 1998); ISP division sold to Westnet c.2003.

events.details: Perth ISP + corporate IT&T; earliest Wayback capture of comswest.com.au 5 Dec 1998.
ISP division sold to Westnet (later iiNet group) c.2003; the Comswest International Pty Ltd parent continued as corporate IT&T / enterprise services.
